Class GameInfo

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.GameInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Represents information about a specific game session. This class is used to encapsulate data about an active or restarted game, including its name, mode, and player counts.
